_doc: Facts about Nous at the locked commit. Sources are paths under orchestrator/ in the Nous repo at that commit. Re-verify every entry when the lock changes.

known_campaign_keys.source: v2/config.py:12-17 _KNOWN_KEYS; other keys are logged and ignored (config.py:56-57)

campaign_keys.source: adapter choice: known_campaign_keys minus human_gates (no code reads it) and rerun_repro (not offered)

ignored_keys.source: not in _KNOWN_KEYS (v2/config.py:12-17), or in it but unread (human_gates)

target_system_keys.source: v2/config.py:50-52 requires repo_path, which the adapter sets itself

optional_passthrough.source: known_campaign_keys rendered verbatim when the request sets them

task_types.source: v2/schemas/problem.schema.json:9 task_type enum (the same enum at v2/schemas/baseline.schema.json:9); one prompts/v2/checklists/<type>.md per value except other (v2/prompts.py:14-21)

completed_stop_reasons.source: v2/schemas/ledger_entry.schema.json:18-20 stop_reason enum (the others are null, halt, stop_sentinel)

native_files.source: v2/resume.py:20, v2/final_check.py:108, v2/hooks.py:144; STOP from cli.py `nous stop`
